summary:
- Declare SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM alongside POST_NOTIFICATIONS, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, and ScheduledNotificationBootReceiver in AndroidManifest.xml (with Android 12-16 inexactAllowWhileIdle fallback and no restricted USE_EXACT_ALARM)
- Harden NotificationService with serialized OS zonedSchedule/cancel queue, 0s lead threshold (scheduling whenever remainingSeconds > 0 and cancelling at 0s/locked), BigTextStyleInformation, warm/cold notification tap callbacks, and explicit OS permission denial detection
- Add foreground spam suppression in GameController while resumed so hitting 100% capacity in-app cancels the status-bar notification and illuminates the Sacred Temple red badge instead
- Route notification taps to the Welcome-Back harvest modal or directly to the Sacred Temple Offertory tab, request POST_NOTIFICATIONS contextually on first Offertory interaction/unlock, and update EN/PT/ES/DE notification strings
- Expand unit and widget tests in offline_offertory_and_notifications_test.dart covering Collect/2x Collect, cap upgrades, short-lead background scheduling, already-full cancellation, foreground suppression, tap routing, permission denial, and AndroidManifest verification
